meta_description_en: Editorial outro for Outlet #005: upcoming features for issue 6, previews of ZX Spectrum utilities, games, and notes for Microdrive and Opus users.
meta_description_ru: Заключительное слово редакторов Outlet #005: планы на шестой выпуск, анонсы программ и утилит для ZX Spectrum, Microdrive и Opus Discovery.
body_en_plain:
That's all for this issue - hope
you enjoyed it! We're so  behind
schedule now that it is hard  to
be definite about next month! We
hope to include BIGTOP,an editor
for TOPCHARS-type characters, an
OUTCLASS article, a simple BASIC
window technique,  some  m/drive
storage box suggestions, EXPEND,
a home expenses calculator,  ZAP
which is a neat utility to CAT +
ERASE microdrive files easily, 1
or 2 simple  graphic  demos  and

more. On cartridge  B  (included
in the Opus Discovery version of
course),will be episode 2 of our
serial: "THAT'S THE TICKET!",the
ON ERROR GO TO utility,a demo of
our BONABANNER  graphic  utility
and THE DREADED MANGLEGROT TREE!

Sorry, Opus users, there seem to
be 2 or  3  microdrive  specific
items. Give us time...

           Ron & Brian

body_en:
That's all for this issue - hope you enjoyed it! We're so behind schedule now that it is hard to be definite about next month! We hope to include BIGTOP, an editor for TOPCHARS-type characters, an OUTCLASS article, a simple BASIC window technique, some m/drive storage box suggestions, EXPEND, a home expenses calculator, ZAP which is a neat utility to CAT + ERASE microdrive files easily, 1 or 2 simple graphic demos and more. On cartridge B (included in the Opus Discovery version of course), will be episode 2 of our serial: "THAT'S THE TICKET!", the ON ERROR GO TO utility, a demo of our BONABANNER graphic utility and THE DREADED MANGLEGROT TREE!

Sorry, Opus users, there seem to be 2 or 3 microdrive specific items. Give us time...

Ron & Brian  
Chezron Software,  
605 Loughborough Road  
Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ  
PRESTEL MAILBOX NO: 014703943

body_ru:
## Выход

Вот и всё в этом выпуске — надеемся, вам понравилось! Мы столь сильно отстали от графика, что трудно сказать что-то точное про следующий месяц! Мы надеемся поместить BIGTOP, редактор знаков типа TOPCHARS, статью OUTCLASS, простую технику окон на BASIC, советы по боксам для m/drive, EXPEND — калькулятор расходов, ZAP — удобную утилиту для лёгких CAT + ERASE на микродрайве, 1 или 2 простых граф-демо и ещё кое-что.

На картридже B (и, конечно, в версии Opus Discovery) выйдет эпизод 2 нашего сериала: "THAT'S THE TICKET!", утилита ON ERROR GO TO, демоверсия нашей граф-утилиты BONABANNER и THE DREADED MANGLEGROT TREE!

Простите, пользователи Opus, тут выходит 2 или 3 сугубо микродрайвовских вещи. Дайте нам время...
